name: Sonnino (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sonnino (a black eagle with a white bend on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Sonnino, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Sonnino arms — black eagle with a white bend on red, crowned, within branches
